Passed In Eca No.10/2015 On The File Of The Additional
Senior Civil Judge, Ramanagara, Dismissing The Claim
Petition For Compensation.
 This Appeal, Coming On For Admission, This Day,

Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice N S Sanjay Gowda

1. Learned counsel for the appellants requests permission of this Court to withdraw the claim petition that had been filed under the provisions of the Employees' Compensation Act, in light of the stand taken by the owner of the vehicle that he had not employed the claimant.
2. Liberty is sought to initiate a proceedings under Section 163A of the Motor Vehicles Act.

3. In my view, it would be appropriate to grant liberty to the appellants to withdraw the claim petition that they NC: 2024:KHC:45728 had filed under the provisions of the Employees'
Compensation Act and permit them to initiate proceedings under Section 163A of the Motor Vehicles Act.
As requested, this appeal is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty reserved to the claimants as stated above.

4. The time spent in prosecuting this proceeding and the proceeding under the Employees'
Compensation Act will stand excluded.
